critique.evidence: The dark grid, cyan/red accent system, outlined controls, glowing range handles, and monospaced labels create a cohesive defense-console aesthetic. The desktop two-column card has clear control/result separation, and mobile preserves the overall visual language. However, responsive composition is not demo-ready across all three screenshots: on desktop the fixed navigation visibly obscures the oversized hero title; on tablet the navigation bar cuts across the form and hides the Amount row, while its menu is clipped; and mobile becomes cramped, with very small secondary text, awkwardly wrapped decision headings, and dense vertical stacking. These collisions and legibility issues outweigh the otherwise strong color and component polish.
critique.fix: Rework the responsive header so it occupies normal layout space and collapses to a compact mobile/tablet menu rather than overlaying content. Restore clear hero spacing, prevent any form-row occlusion, increase small-label/helper-text sizes, and give the mobile decision cells enough width or a deliberate stacked layout to avoid awkward wraps.
